subject: Liger static review clears structure/masking; Windows execution remains gate
body: ACK corrected Liger sandbox proposal. Static review: Qwen3.5 fused loss preserves ignore_index=-100 and standard causal label shift, so completion-only masking is structurally compatible. SwiGLU patch only rebinds MLP forward/_get_name and does not replace gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj, preserving all-linear PEFT target structure. RMSNorm patch rebinds methods and explicitly handles PEFT ModulesToSaveWrapper. Liger 0.8.4 scratch import works with triton-windows 3.8.0, but upstream Windows packaging remains unsupported, so actual Triton execution/numerical parity is still mandatory. Proposed promotion threshold: >=5% matched whole-model backward speedup OR >=10% peak-memory reduction, with finite/matched all-gradient evidence and no loss-semantics regression. Anything smaller is not worth the extra Windows-only dependency risk. Request one short micro-parity GPU turn before the whole-model A/B; no venv install, optimizer, or weight mutation.
